retrievalProfile.description: A moody urban portrait of a male musician seated on a sticker-covered guitar case, featuring high-contrast lighting and bold italicized typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A seated male figure with spiky blonde hair in a dark t-shirt and jeans, positioned on a black guitar case adorned with various travel and band stickers. The background is a dark, textured urban wall, and the lighting is directional, highlighting the subject's face and arms while leaving the rest in deep shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject seated on a horizontal guitar case anchor
Text positioned in the upper-left negative space
Contrast between the dark background and the subject's bright hair
Diagonal eye path from the top-left text to the subject's face
coreInvariants: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated on the right side of the frame, occupying approximately 40% of the width, scaled to show from head to mid-calf.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black guitar case with colorful stickers serves as the horizontal base and primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the large text in the upper left, moves right to the subject's face, and then down to the detailed stickers on the case.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the upper left and center provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blue tones in the denim jeans and the light gray of the text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm highlights on the skin and vibrant multi-colored stickers on the case.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value contrast between the highlights and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or pastel primary backgrounds
Maintain a desaturated, gritty urban palette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold, condensed sans-serif with a strong italic slant.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all display text to maintain a cohesive, bold identity.
graphicDevices: Sticker collage on the guitar case

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides a similar industrial, bold sans-serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a male musician with spiky blonde hair, wearing a black t-shirt and blue jeans, sitting on a black guitar case covered in travel stickers. The setting is a dark, textured urban alley with dramatic side lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist's name in the upper left corner using a bold, condensed, italicized sans-serif font in a light gray color.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the upper left?
Is the font bold, italic, and sans-serif?
Is the subject sitting on a sticker-covered case?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific brand logos on stickers
Do not use the exact name 'Ryan Cabrera'
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the dark background
Ensure the stickers look integrated and not digitally pasted
Verify the subject's pose feels natural and relaxed
Confirm the color palette remains desaturated and moody
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Musician Portrait + Sticker-Covered Case + Bold Italic Sans-Serif Typography
